missing_policy: refuse evaluation until all labels and ambiguity are explicitly completed
uncertain_policy: exclude uncertain human cells from category-specific metrics; disclose counts
complaint_metric_policy: all-known detection plus decided-only metrics; unknown states stay distinct
undefined_metric_policy: complaint ratios with zero denominator are null; sentiment reuses disclosed baseline zero_division=0
cohort_policy: primary150 and targeted20 separately; unused90 never read by evaluation; no prevalence claims
threshold_policy: reuse exact saved complaint thresholds; no fitting, calibration or optimisation
